messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention "零假設檢定的標準差" which might be "standard error" or "standard deviation of the sampling distribution"? They want to compute the standard deviation of the null hypothesis test? They provide sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, population mean 98.6. They want to compute the standard deviation of the test statistic? That would be the standard error: sigma / sqrt(n). But they have sample std dev, not population sigma. For t-test, we use sample std dev as estimate of sigma. So standard error = s / sqrt(n) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249. 1.4/6.3249=0.2213. So standard error ~0.221. They might want to compute the standard deviation of the null hypothesis test? That is the standard error. So answer: 0.221.

But maybe they want to compute the standard deviation of the null hypothesis test? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" could refer to the standard deviation of the sampling distribution under H0. That is indeed the standard error. So answer: 0.221.

We can also compute the t-statistic: (98.2-98.6)/0.221 = -0.4/0.221 = -1.809. But they didn't ask for t-statistic. They asked for standard deviation. So answer: 0.221.
